mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing output and economic activity, which directly supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month rolling median, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.
